risk_note: RV2 (catalog, links registered from rank cards). GET /v1/rank/hot (F-PROD-13, BR-TEXT-17 / BR-TEXT-13 / BR-PROD-03; refs carried in the ledger comment per #1748): only selectable sales / popularity channels of specs/material-channels.yaml, checked before each fetch; categories from the channel and category / cursor validated (20001); items in channel order with the channel's rank kept, a skipped card leaving a gap (D10-422 ②); sales_text passed through or null; cards through catalog's single card entry, registering a link with its quote snapshot and never converting; cache per (platform, channel, category, page) for rank.cache_ttl_seconds (registered by B1-28g), the stale copy served on a union outage; 50304 rank_unavailable without a compliant channel, 50304 without reason on an outage without cache. getHotRank is no longer planned; codegen and the route generators were rerun. Known limit: union has no channel-scoped hot-list port (MaterialReq carries only a cursor) and union internals are outside this task's paths, so the production upstream answers as a union outage behind a TODO until a union task adds the port with CAP-*-10 records (reported to the orchestrator); the whitelist is empty today, so production answers rank_unavailable first. No money moves. The full verify on the test machine gave no result within 3600 s; this task's nine rule-test files (29 tests) passed in verify:fast; per D10-319 the required CI decides. Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so the rule tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
